title: The Family That Claimed A Sea Fort As A Country
description:
Sealand is an unrecognised micronation on HM Fort Roughs, a WWII sea fort built in 1943 in the North Sea. In 1967 pirate radio owner Paddy Roy Bates occupied it and declared independence. After warning shots at British workmen in 1968, a court ruled the fort was outside British territorial limits at the time. Sealand later introduced a constitution, flag, anthem, currency and passports, survived a 1978 attack by hired mercenaries, and was once offered for sale for 750 million euros. Its population is normally about two people.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Principality of Sealand'. The flag in the animation is our own design.

Would you move to a sea fort? Tell us in the comments.
